title: Battle of Beni Mered
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Beni Mered", at revision 1370107675, opens: "The Battle of Beni Mered took place in April 1842 between the French forces and the Algerian resistance from southern Algiers. The French had established a military reserve camp around the town of Beni Mered between Blida and Boufarik." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q28717510, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1842 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
